Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: After finding the article link at step 4, the WebServing_Expert incorrectly stopped short of verification, claiming inability to access external content and repeatedly deferring the check to the user instead of using available browsing capability or handing off to the file-reading agent to open the PDF and confirm pp. 45–46. This caused the loop with no verification and the correct outcome (“cloak”) was never delivered.
